script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let ability be a weighted random move of arg.
Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled "self_reflect" on arg.
Let data be {}.
If not call game:ai.AiUtil.getIgnoresReflectionByAbilityId with (arg, ability), then set data's 'activeTarget' to arg.
Arg uses ability2 with its cast time and then [{abilityId: ability2}, {abilityId: ability, abilityOptions: data}].

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
Let part be part 1 of executer.
If every x in list where part x of executer is dead, then
  Set globalRegister's '_stateIdAfterRecover' to arg → get-state-id.
  Arg → set-next-state-id with (21).
Otherwise, if part → is-in-reflection, then
  Let ability be a weighted random move of part.
  If call game:ai.AiUtil.getIgnoresReflectionByAbilityId with (part, ability), then part uses ability.
  Otherwise, part uses ability with options {activeTarget: part}.
Otherwise, call helper with (part).
